name: Seedance2 Api
summary: End-to-end AI video generation from storyboard concept to final output. Supports both MCP and standalone Python script modes; automatically detects availability and switches gracefully if MCP is unavailable. Generates reference images with Seedream 4.5 (text-to-image and image editing), then submits video tasks to Seedance 2.0 with configurable aspect ratios and durations.
